analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 탈출, MACD 개선세 지속
analysis.reason: 직전 매수 진단 이후 RSI 60.5 → 61.1 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 또한 292.4824 → 327.9169 개선세 지속. 5일 저가 37,300원 대비 현재가 40,105원 상승하며 Higher Low 패턴 형성. 상승 추세 유지 및 매수 관점 강화.
analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy signal, RSI rose from 60.5 to 61.1, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram also continued to improve from 292.4824 to 327.9169. The 5-day low of 37,300 won against the current price of 40,105, forming a Higher Low pattern. Uptrend maintained and buy perspective strengthened.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· RSI Trajectory (53.5→61.1) + Exiting oversold, interpreting upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (292.4824→327.9169) + Improvement diagnosis, strengthening trend reversal signal.

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Uptrend) + Buy entry conditions met.
